claimsVerdicts.claim: C4. GitHub Actions || semantics give canonical-preferred, alias-fallback
claimsVerdicts.evidence: Documented expression semantics: an unset secret evaluates to the empty string, which is falsy; 'A || B' returns A if A is truthy, else B. GitHub does not allow creating an empty-string secret (API/UI reject empty values), so set ⇒ non-empty ⇒ truthy. Therefore: canonical set → canonical; canonical unset + MAIN_KEY set → MAIN_KEY (today's state); both unset → '' → the -z gate refuses. No workflow annotation/warning is emitted for secrets missing from expressions on schedule/dispatch runs (silent empty-string evaluation), so no log-noise or behavioral risk.
